additional_gaps.detail: Official ins3147718 link known; record version and table IDs unconfirmed; no tables acquired or crosschecked
Official ins3144373 link and paper DOI165871 known; version/table identity unconfirmed; no tables acquired or crosschecked
DOI redirect stopped at host allowlist; publisher bytes not acquired
HTTP200 body is Client Challenge, not a paper; retained raw rejection evidence only
Eight Table2 mass rows present; cross-section curves, quantile bands and auxiliary numerical data absent
216 declared (model,n,MD) mass-threshold slots; only two observed scalar mass limits explicitly quoted; expected limits and full curves unavailable
21 (MS,gs) mass-threshold slots, all scalar limits null; cross-section curves unavailable
15 (Esph,pNCS) prefactor slots; only E9,p0.5 observed/expected available; cross sections and expected bands unavailable
HTML rendering contains grouped parameter ranges and censored <2/>6; no unambiguous typed contour normalization implemented; original paper retained
N>=4 sigma*A slot explicit; remaining multiplicity axes and all numerical curve points not tabulated locally
Abstract event-fraction claim differs from Eq2/section9 dimensionless prefactor; no equality or conversion inferred
Internal wording conflict, NOT a byte/version change: section3 defines C2 nonrotating, section9 groups C2 with rotating scenarios. Definition retained; independent source reconciliation pending
Detailed generator cards, lifetime/charge/BR/loss/remnant assumptions not all explicitly available; comparison groups remain null
Agent-reviewed extraction is not independent human ACCEPTED data; raw-local lineage and code tests do not establish physics truth
